TRAE AI Creativity Competition Prototype

PersonaBot, a talking robot that changes character by command.

PersonaBot is an AI robot concept with a small rectangular command prompt and a ChatGPT/Gemini-style talk system. Type or speak commands like /mom, /dad, /daddy, /friend, /teacher, or /custom to switch its personality, expression, and voice style.

Emotional voice Replies change when you sound excited, stressed, curious, or sad.
Free talk You can ask anything. Commands are optional, not required.
TRAE-style app Assistant status, live mode, and voice-first workflow.

Character modes

Controls

Voice uses the browser’s built-in speech system, so it works best in modern browsers.

Real AI mode

Real AI: checking local proxy

If the local proxy is running, PersonaBot asks real AI first. If not, it uses the built-in demo brain.

Self-learning memory

Memory: empty. Say “remember that...” or “my name is...” to teach PersonaBot.

Skills

Use quick commands for writing, translation, summaries, coding, weather, Wikipedia, memory, and ideas.

Demo prompts

Click one to test how the robot responds.

ChatGPT/Gemini-style talk

Users can type or press Mic to speak, then the robot replies out loud with a typing indicator.

Switchable personalities

Each command changes the robot’s response style, color theme, face expression, and voice settings.

Competition-ready concept

The idea is easy to demo and shows how AI can become more personal, useful, and creative.
